description: This file defines the ClaimExpense entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. It maps the source code to a database table 'ohrm_expense' using Doctrine ORM annotations. The class includes properties such as id, expense type, date, amount, note, claim request, and deletion status, along with their respective getters and setters. It also uses traits and decorators for extended functionality.

classes.name: ClaimExpense
classes.description: Entity class representing an expense claim record associated with expense type, date, amount, optional note, and linked claim request within the OrangeHRM system. Implements ORM mappings for database persistence and uses traits and decorators for additional behavior.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the expense record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the expense record.

methods.name: getExpenseType
methods.description: Returns the expense type associated with this expense.

methods.name: setExpenseType
methods.description: Assigns an expense type to this expense record.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the expense.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the expense.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the expense.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount of the expense.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the optional note associated with the expense.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the optional note for the expense.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Returns the claim request this expense is associated with.

methods.name: setClaimRequest
methods.description: Associates a claim request with this expense.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the expense record is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense record as deleted or active.
